The '''SW1-04 Computer Repair Droid''' was a small, mouse-like [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. SW1-04s were among the diverse population of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] stationed aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Field Secured Container Vessel|container train]] [[Black Ice/Legends|''Black Ice''.]]<ref name="BI">*[[Black Ice (adventure)|''Black Ice'']]</ref>
